entry.summary:
Blockchain payment systems promise transparency, speed, and lower transaction costs — but they also raise the stakes on security. A bug in a traditional backend might cause downtime. My dad runs a small trucking company in Texas. Last year, his 2018 Kenworth T680 threw SPN 3226 FMI 0 — NOx sensor circuit failure. The dealership quoted $650.
